title: 下班后要回消息吗？看微软的团队约定示例
topic: 工作边界与跨时区协作

source.title: Sections of a Working Agreement
source.context: 原文是微软公开工程手册中的团队工作约定示例，不是微软所有团队统一实行的作息制度。
paragraphs: A working agreement is a document, or a set of documents that describe how we work together as a team and what our expectations and principles are.
The working agreement created by the team at the beginning of the project, and is stored in the repository so that it is readily available for everyone working on the project.

The following are examples of sections and points that can be part of a working agreement but each team should compose their own, and adjust times, communication channels, branch naming policies etc. to fit their team needs.
We work as one team towards a common goal and clear scope
We make sure everyone's voice is heard, listened to
We show all team members equal respect
We work as a team to have common expectations for technical delivery that are documented in a Team Manifesto.
We make sure to spread our expertise and skills in the team, so no single person is relied on for one skill
We communicate all information relevant to the team through the Project Teams channel
We add all technical spikes, trade studies, and other technical documentation to the project repository through async design reviews in PRs
Our office hours, when we can expect to collaborate via Microsoft Teams, phone or face-to-face are Monday to Friday 10AM - 5PM
We are not expected to answer emails past 6PM, on weekends or when we are on holidays or vacation.
We work in different time zones and respect this, especially when setting up recurring meetings.
We record meetings when possible, so that team members who could not attend live can listen later.
translations: 团队工作约定是一份或一组文档，说明团队怎样协作，以及彼此有哪些期望和原则。
团队在项目开始时制定工作约定，并把它保存在项目代码库中，方便参与项目的每个人随时查阅。
以下内容是工作约定中可能包含的章节和条款示例。每个团队都应根据自身需求拟定约定，并调整时间、沟通渠道、分支命名规则等细节。
我们作为一个团队，朝着共同目标和明确的工作范围协作。
我们确保每个人的声音都能被听到、被认真对待。
我们平等尊重团队中的每一位成员。
我们作为团队，就技术交付形成共同期望，并把它记录在《团队宣言》中。
我们让专业知识和技能在团队中流动，避免某项技能只依赖一个人。
我们通过项目 Teams 频道沟通所有与团队有关的信息。
我们通过 PR 中的异步设计评审，将技术调研、方案比较和其他技术文档加入项目代码库。
周一至周五上午 10 点至下午 5 点是我们的办公协作时间；这段时间可以通过 Microsoft Teams、电话或面对面协作。
下午 6 点后、周末、节假日或休假期间，我们不被要求回复邮件。
我们分处不同的时区，并尊重这一点；安排定期会议时尤其如此。
条件允许时，我们会录制会议，方便无法实时参加的团队成员之后收听。
fullTextParagraphs: A working agreement is a document, or a set of documents that describe how we work together as a team and what our expectations and principles are.
The working agreement created by the team at the beginning of the project, and is stored in the repository so that it is readily available for everyone working on the project.

The following are examples of sections and points that can be part of a working agreement but each team should compose their own, and adjust times, communication channels, branch naming policies etc. to fit their team needs.
We work as one team towards a common goal and clear scope
We make sure everyone's voice is heard, listened to
We show all team members equal respect
We work as a team to have common expectations for technical delivery that are documented in a Team Manifesto.
We make sure to spread our expertise and skills in the team, so no single person is relied on for one skill
All times below are listed in CET
We communicate all information relevant to the team through the Project Teams channel
We add all technical spikes, trade studies, and other technical documentation to the project repository through async design reviews in PRs
Our office hours, when we can expect to collaborate via Microsoft Teams, phone or face-to-face are Monday to Friday 10AM - 5PM
We are not expected to answer emails past 6PM, on weekends or when we are on holidays or vacation.
We work in different time zones and respect this, especially when setting up recurring meetings.
We record meetings when possible, so that team members who could not attend live can listen later.
We agree on a Definition of Done for our user story's and sprints and live by it.
We follow engineering best practices like the Engineering Fundamentals Engineering Playbook
The Process Lead is responsible for leading any scrum or agile practices to enable the project to move forward.
Facilitate standup meetings and hold team accountable for attendance and participation.
Keep the meeting moving as described in the Project Standup page.
Make sure all action items are documented and ensure each has an owner and a due date and tracks the open issues.
Notes as needed after planning / stand-ups.
Make sure that items are moved to the parking lot and ensure follow-up afterwards.
Maintain a location showing team’s work and status and removing impediments that are blocking the team.
Hold the team accountable for results in a supportive fashion.
Make sure that project and program documentation are up-to-date.
Guarantee the tracking/following up on action items from retrospectives (iteration and release planning) and from daily standup meetings.
Facilitate the sprint retrospective.
Coach Product Owner and the team in the process, as needed.
We work together on a Definition of Ready and all user stories assigned to a sprint need to follow this
We communicate what we are working on through the board
We assign ourselves a task when we are ready to work on it (not before) and move it to active
We capture any work we do related to the project in a user story/task
We close our tasks/user stories only when they are done (as described in the Definition of Done)
We work with the PM if we want to add a new user story to the sprint

If we add new tasks to the board, we make sure it matches the acceptance criteria of the user story (to avoid scope creep). If it doesn't match the acceptance criteria we should discuss with the PM to see if we need a new user story for the task or if we should adjust the acceptance criteria.
We follow the git flow branch naming convention for branches and identify the task number e.g. feature/123-add-working-agreement
We merge all code into main branches through PRs
All PRs are reviewed by one person from and one from Microsoft (for knowledge transfer and to ensure code and security standards are met)
We always review existing PRs before starting work on a new task
We look through open PRs at the end of stand-up to make sure all PRs have reviewers.
We treat documentation as code and apply the same standards to Markdown as code

notes.phrase: how we work together as a team
notes.explain: how 引出具体的协作方式，适合写在团队约定的开头。
notes.example: Let's agree on how we work together before the project starts.

notes.phrase: each team should compose their own
notes.explain: 原文强调这些条款只是示例，不能把示例时间当成全公司制度。
notes.example: Each team should set its own response-time expectations.

notes.meaning: 每个人都能发声并被听见
notes.explain: voice 在此指意见；is heard 用被动语态强调意见得到回应。
notes.example: Before we decide, let's make sure everyone's voice is heard.

notes.meaning: 通过项目 Teams 频道
notes.explain: through 表示沟通渠道，可替换成团队实际使用的平台。
notes.example: Please share project updates through the team channel.

notes.phrase: We are not expected to answer emails past 6PM
notes.meaning: 晚上 6 点后不要求回邮件
notes.explain: be expected to 表示工作期望；否定形式是在说明边界，而不是承诺所有消息都可以延后。
notes.example: We are not expected to reply outside agreed working hours.

notes.phrase: respect this, especially when setting up recurring meetings
notes.meaning: 安排例会时尤其要尊重时区差异
notes.explain: especially when ... 用来把抽象原则落到具体工作动作。
notes.example: We should respect time zones, especially when scheduling the weekly review.

scenario.title: Setting a team response-time agreement
english: Lina's project team works across Shanghai and Berlin. A recurring meeting is scheduled for 7:30 p.m. in Shanghai, and people often receive follow-up messages later that evening.

Lina proposes a working agreement: “Could we set a shared collaboration window and move the weekly meeting to a time that works for both locations? We could also clarify which messages need an urgent response.”
The team agrees on a meeting time and writes down the exceptions. Nobody has to guess whether a routine update needs an immediate reply.
chinese: Lina 的项目团队分布在上海和柏林。固定会议安排在上海时间晚上 7:30，会后大家还常收到消息。
Lina 提议建立团队工作约定：‘我们能否设定共同协作时段，并把例会改到两地都方便的时间？也可以明确哪些消息需要紧急回复。’
团队确定了会议时间，并写下例外情况。日常进展是否需要马上回复，大家不用再猜。

firstAttempt.prompt: 跨时区团队成员常在晚上收到普通进度消息，不确定是否要立刻回复。请用英文建议约定异步更新方式，并明确什么情况才需要即时联系。
firstAttempt.sample: Could we post routine updates in the shared project channel and agree on what counts as urgent? That way, everyone knows when an immediate response is actually needed.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把日常进展改为异步更新，并让团队共同明确紧急消息的边界。

words.example: Our working agreement explains when the team is available.
words.translation: 我们的工作约定说明团队何时可以协作。
words.note: 这里指团队共同拟定的协作方式。

words.example: Let's set clear expectations for reply times.
words.translation: 我们把回复时间的期望说清楚。
words.note: 职场沟通常用复数 expectations。

words.example: Please post routine updates in the project channel.
words.translation: 请在项目频道发布日常进展。
words.note: 按实际工具替换 Project Teams channel。

words.example: We collaborate across three time zones.
words.translation: 我们跨越三个时区协作。

words.example: The recurring meeting should work for both offices.
words.translation: 固定例会的时间应适合两地办公室。
words.note: 常用于日历和会议安排。

words.example: We are not expected to reply on weekends.
words.translation: 我们不被要求在周末回复。
words.note: be expected to 表示约定或惯例中的期望。

structure.original: We are not expected to answer emails past 6PM, on weekends or when we are on holidays or vacation.
analysis: We are not expected to ...：明确团队没有这项回复义务。
past 6PM, on weekends or when ...：并列列出适用时间。
这是示例条款；实际团队应按时区和业务需要自行商定。
structure.transfer: Our team is not expected to answer routine messages outside the agreed collaboration window.

rewrite.good: Could we agree on a shared collaboration window and clarify which requests need an urgent response?
rewrite.translation: 我们能否商定共同协作时段，并明确哪些请求需要紧急回复？
rewrite.pattern: Could we agree on ... and clarify which ...?

cloze.prompt: Could we post routine updates in the shared project ___?
cloze.why: 共享频道让普通更新可以异步查看。

cloze.prompt: Could we agree on what counts as ___?
cloze.why: 明确 urgent 的标准，避免普通消息被当成紧急事项。

cloze.prompt: Everyone will know when an immediate response is actually ___.
cloze.why: needed 表示只有在约定情形下才需要立即回复。

dictation.text: We are not expected to reply on weekends.
dictation.why: 注意 not expected to 的完整表达。

dictation.text: We work in different time zones and respect this.
dictation.why: 注意 time zones 的复数。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否把日常进展发到共享项目频道？
translationPractice.answer: Could we post routine updates in the shared project channel?
translationPractice.why: 本句练习“post routine updates in the shared project channel”在把普通进展放在共享频道异步更新时的用法。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否约定什么情况算紧急？
translationPractice.answer: Could we agree on what counts as urgent?
translationPractice.why: 本句练习“agree on what counts as urgent”在共同约定什么情况需要紧急处理时的用法。

choice.prompt: 上海团队每周都要在晚上参加与欧洲团队的例会。请用两句英文说明时间问题，并建议团队确定共同协作时段和紧急消息的回复规则。
options: The current weekly meeting is late for the Shanghai team. Could we agree on a shared collaboration window and clarify which messages need an urgent reply?
No one should ever message after 6 p.m.
choice.why: 把例会时间和紧急消息规则分开说清，便于跨时区团队共同确认。

output.prompt: 客服团队需要约定非工作时间的升级规则。请用英文建议把普通问题放在共享工单里异步跟进，并共同定义哪些情况需要即时联系。
output.sample: Could we post routine requests in the shared support queue and agree on what counts as urgent? That way, everyone knows when an immediate response is actually needed.
check: 是否为普通进度更新提出异步渠道？
是否建议明确紧急情况的边界？
是否说明约定可以减少对即时回复的猜测？
